# Ishavasyam.org

> Ishavasyam.org is an independent space-research and educational initiative exploring space science, astronomy, Indic cosmology and consciousness through respectful scholarship and evidence-based scientific inquiry.

## Meaning of Ishavasyam

"Ishavasyam" is derived from the opening teaching of the Isha Upanishad and may be understood as "all existence is pervaded or enveloped by the Divine." For Ishavasyam.org, this principle inspires a humble, responsible and evidence-based exploration of the universe.

## Primary Research Areas

- Space science and astronomy
- Planetary and cosmological studies
- Indic cosmology and ancient knowledge systems
- Consciousness and fundamental questions
- Science education and interdisciplinary collaboration

## Scientific Integrity

Ishavasyam.org distinguishes spiritual and philosophical interpretations from experimentally validated scientific knowledge. Ancient wisdom may inspire questions, while scientific claims require observation, evidence, testing and transparent review.

## Affiliation

Ishavasyam.org is an independent research and educational initiative. It is not affiliated with ISRO, NASA, IN-SPACe, any university, government agency or religious institution.
